source_formula_reference.use: only for independently identified native evolution state and onset YLD0; DAMA is not silently that state

minimum_native_admission: Existing Starter must report syntax-checked normal termination, zero warnings/errors and exact units.
Existing Engine normal termination and owned-command cleanup must be recorded separately from sample coverage.
Every selected bulk must have exact PART/MAT/PROP/element, Isolid24, one IP and FAILIP1.
Raw TFILE4 and TITLES must bind to expected group/member/tokens; missing or invalid channels are not zeros.

To claim observed softening/deletion, record nontrivial DAMAGE_SUM samples, at least one active-to-inactive transition and independent stress/plastic history. Otherwise that criterion is UNKNOWN/NOT_OBSERVED.
comparison_quantities: initial native VOL versus declared geometry; do not multiply arbitrary time-dependent IE density into Gf
actual global TIME STEP distribution for CFL change, not only requested output interval
per-element DAMA/OFF/deletion-time brackets, PLAS and stress softening; native unique initiation/evolution if genuinely recorded
retained-sample extrema and actual-time sampled integrals only when channel meaning and complete interval are verified

numerical_comparison_rules.native_volume: relative error <= 1e-6 is serialization/geometry readback check only
numerical_comparison_rules.clock: strictly increasing actual times; no endpoint fabrication or gap bridging
numerical_comparison_rules.deletion: report last-active/first-inactive brackets; exact failure time UNKNOWN absent separate channel
numerical_comparison_rules.global_energy_time_sensitivity: report relative differences of retained maxima and final observations; 5% is a predeclared screening limit, not physical certification; differing endpoint coverage makes final-value comparison UNKNOWN
numerical_comparison_rules.mesh_objectivity: NOT_CERTIFIED from two meshes, TABLE scaling or volume integral; retain quantitative differences
numerical_comparison_rules.unavailable_damage_dissipation: UNKNOWN; no global IE subtraction substitute
numerical_comparison_rules.failed_case: retain original state and raw; no post-failure tolerance widening

After complete cohesive deletion, opposing bulk TYPE24 recontact/reopen with native reaction/penetration.
No dual cohesive/contact compressive support over relevant native increments; scheduled activation and sample audit alone are insufficient.
